tasks.title: Announcement #59
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university event.
tasks.transcript: Attention everyone. We are thrilled to announce that the university's annual science symposium will be held next Thursday at 2 p.m. in the main hall. This event will showcase groundbreaking research by faculty and students. We hope to see you there.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：We are thrilled to announce that the university's annual science symposium will be held next Thursday at 2 p.m. in the main hall. 选项分析： A. A student meeting 一次学生会议。公告中未提及学生会议，所以A选项错误。 B. A lecture series 一次系列讲座。公告中提到的是研讨会（symposium），并非系列讲座，所以B选项错误。 C. A new research project 一个新的研究项目。公告中未提及新研究项目，所以C选项错误。 D. An upcoming Science Symposium 一场即将到来的科学研讨会。公告明确宣布年度科学研讨会的时间地点，所以D选项正确。

questions.stem: What does the speaker hope the listeners will do?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：说话者希望听众做什么？ 定位原文：We hope to see you there. 选项分析： A. Submit their research 提交他们的研究。公告中未提及提交研究，所以A选项错误。 B. Join a research group 加入一个研究小组。公告中未提及加入研究小组，所以B选项错误。 C. Attend the symposium 参加研讨会。说话者说“希望在那里见到你”，即希望听众到场参加研讨会，所以C选项正确。 D. Prepare for a lecture 为一场讲座做准备。公告中未提及讲座或要求听众做准备，所以D选项错误。
